# Artemis II lifts off from Kennedy Space Center

The first crewed mission of NASA's Artemis campaign is under way.

The crew launched aboard the European Space Agency's Orion spacecraft atop the Space Launch System rocket. The mission will send NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover and Christina Koch and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen on a journey around the Moon and back to Earth.
